External backtest endpoint with backtest-specific schema.

The PublicBacktestRequest provides clear OpenAPI documentation with backtest-specific
parameters (backtest_size, start_date) directly visible (no discriminated union).

get.description: Get the status of a background task.

Get the result of a completed background task.

Applies external response filtering as defense-in-depth: even though workflows
submitted via the external API produce filtered responses, this ensures results
retrieved via this endpoint always have internal-only fields stripped.

Generate a temporary download link for forecast/backtest results or input data.

**Supported resource types:**
- `response:{session_id}` — Forecast/backtest results as **JSON** (.json)
- `data:{session_id}` — Input dataset as **Parquet** (.parquet)

**File formats** (type-specific serialization):
| Prefix | Format | Use with |
|--------|--------|----------|
| `response:` | JSON | Any JSON viewer, text editor, or programming language |
| `data:` | Parquet | pandas, PySpark, DuckDB, or other columnar data tools |

Returns HTTP 302 redirect to a time-limited Azure Blob SAS URL.
The client should follow the redirect to download the file directly from storage.

parameters.name: resource_id
parameters.description: Session artifact ID with type prefix. Format: `{type}:{session_id}` where type is `response` or `data`.

302.description: Redirect to download URL. Follow the Location header to download the resource.

400.description: Invalid resource ID. Must use `response:` or `data:` prefix.

501.description: Storage backend doesn't support shareable links

end_date.title: End Date
end_date.description: Optional end date for the data to consider for forecasting. If provided, data beyond this date will be ignored.

run_explain.description: Whether to compute feature importance explanations during backtest. Defaults to False.

include_genai_summary.description: Whether to generate GenAI natural language summary of explanations. Requires run_explain=True and LLM configuration.

start_date.title: Start Date
start_date.description: Start timestamp for the backtest. Must be provided together with end_date. Mutually exclusive with backtest_size (unless derived from previous run).

PublicBenchmarkRequest.description:
Request body for public /benchmark endpoint.

Runs multi-model benchmark comparison using the primary model defined in
backtest_config.forecaster against default comparison models.

NOTE: The 'models' field is NOT exposed in the public API. External consumers
always use the default comparison models: ["flowstate", "chronos", "ridge",
"mean_forecaster", "naive"]. Internal API users can specify custom comparison
models via the full ToolsMsg schema at /internal/benchmark.

Benchmark operations default to background=True since they are long-running.
